title: HHHusher setup picker (v2)
description: A full-bleed dark photo band with a picker on the left: a two-line heading, a numbered list of setups (small grey number squares and grey mono caps; the chosen one turns yellow), the chosen setup's paragraph and a yellow buy button. Picking another setup crossfades the photo; the list fades in item by item as it comes up the window.
notes: always dark (forces the dark class); one photo slot per setup, cropped like cover
sized by the window on phones (100svh), by its content on desktop, like the original
needs JavaScript to switch setups (hydrate: visible); without it the first setup shows
name: hhhusher-v2-mic-setups
